recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the original R5 clarification, accounts for the later R6 RelativeTime addition, and limits the source change to the two active definitions targeted by FHIR-29799.
issue_request: FHIR-29799 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request asking for clarification of timing datatype choices in PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition, especially that Range can represent a range of ages and that Duration is an offset. The final resolution agreed to clarify timing usages in both resources for R5.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-29799-tagged source commit was found. Commit 1b8c8728485bc9bfa8dcc454047dba518eca81e5 for FHIR-25471 removed dateTime and Period from the definitional timing choices and added the comments that explained Age, Duration, Range, and Timing; Jira FHIR-29799 later records that the issue was already applied.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-43696 added RelativeTime to ActivityDefinition.timing[x] and PlanDefinition.action.timing[x] for R6 in commit da29739dd3adc2ede0ac9a81320c996dcd664096, but that commit only added the choice type entries and did not update the explanatory comments. The RelativeTime datatype source describes a time or time period relative to an event with a Duration or Range offset. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Added one sentence to each affected timing[x] comment explaining that RelativeTime expresses expected timing as an offset or offset range from an event described by the RelativeTime. No cardinality, type-list, or unrelated narrative changes were made.
source_changes: source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml: extended ActivityDefinition.timing[x] comment to explain the RelativeTime timing choice.
source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml: extended PlanDefinition.action.timing[x] comment to explain the RelativeTime timing choice.
